title: Why Japanese Restaurants Hang Noren
description: A noren is a split shop curtain at many Japanese restaurants and bathhouses. It often signals open-for-business, splits the doorway, and is not magic—and not every shop uses one.
h2: How Shopkeepers Treat a Piece of Cloth as a Sign
A Doorway Sign You Can Walk Through
search_intent: informational — what noren are for (open/closed, doorway split); not every shop; sento too; not unique magic
